title: Q-Relay virtualised emulation artifact - minor revision R1
description: Versioned research software and data artifact for Q-Relay minor revision R1. Source/scripts/configuration/formal models are MIT. Checkpoints, generated data, plots, reports and technical documentation are CC BY 4.0, as explicitly mapped in LICENSE_ASSIGNMENTS.json; the primary software license does not relicense data. Includes three independent fixed-final checkpoints per A0-A3 arm, paired controller outcomes, B3 inference sensitivity with negative outcomes, frozen stochastic streams and local-EVM evidence. All primary ablation intervals include zero; none is Holm-significant. Shared scenarios are not independent training replicates. Node-count scaling is analytical only; withdrawn B4 sweeps and manuscripts/author portraits are excluded. No A4/A5, board SRAM/stack, enclave execution, native on-chain ML-DSA or public finality measurement is claimed. Scientific source/checkpoint bytes are preserved; privacy-redacted metadata copies have explicit original/candidate/published provenance and are not falsely represented as retaining original canonical receipt hashes.
